title: The Episode About Shamas Khan and Baizid Khan

blocks.text: Banda chooses to strike directly at Shams al-Din, meeting mounted force with personal aggression until the commander is wounded, overwhelmed, and finally destroyed.
His death shatters the remaining order, and companions such as Baizid retreat or perish while trying to escape the consequences of the failed stand.
The page is built around the fall of shams al-Din, making his death the center of military and symbolic reversal.
